knowledge_gaps: Candidate-conditioned attention adds complexity beyond the starting recurrence-pooling idea. Include CE plus candidate-independent recency pooling to determine whether candidate conditioning justifies its cost. Originality 5/10 is plausible; potential 8/10 is speculative, and difficulty 5/10 may understate causal scoring and catalog-inference work.

The recurrence alternative lacks an equation, recurrence statistic, and sparse-history fallback. Positional decay measures interaction distance, not elapsed time; neither establishes that a need is currently satisfied.

The residual is bounded by beta only if beta is constrained and normalization is numerically safe. Its influence relative to unnormalized SASRec logits remains unspecified. An exactly zero gate also initially blocks gradients into the attention branch.

Reproduction requires explicit negative counts, sampling with or without replacement, duplicate handling, positive exclusion rules, loss reduction, temperature, optimizer settings, gate initialization, and checkpoint selection. The actual positive must always be excluded from negatives.

Causal backbone states alone do not prevent leakage if candidate attention accesses future states. Specify prefix and padding masks, all-padding behavior, and how log2feats retains history for predict_score without breaking the diagnostic contract.

No measured validation baseline, bounded search schedule, or runtime estimate supports the proposed ablations within 43,200 GPU-seconds. Candidate attention can require O(BKL²d) training work and O(NLd) catalog-scoring work; chunking bounds memory but does not remove computation.

Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category risks validation overfitting. Use paired per-user comparisons and uncertainty estimates alongside the fixed macro HR@10. Training margins and feedback from twenty simulator users cannot establish improved compatibility, current demand, or reduced redundancy.
